cues.text: Footage from a camera high in a corner of the dorm lounge. Shinjiro sits alone on the sofa watching a cooking show on the television, with Koromaru sitting nearby.
Shinjiro hurriedly lies down on the sofa and keeps still, as if asleep. Koromaru gets up as the front door opens.
Fuuka and Aigis walk in from the entrance, and Koromaru goes to meet them.
Fuuka hurries Aigis away across the lounge and out of sight. Shinjiro, alone again with Koromaru, looks crestfallen.
